content:
If you're like me, you've probably spent too much time browsing through endless random articles on Wikipedia, getting completely lost in the rabbit hole. Now there's finally an official app for that—well, more like a widget, actually.

There's finally a button that takes you straight to a random Wikipedia article.

The latest update to the Wikipedia iOS app introduces a rather fun and practical new feature: a random article widget for the iPhone and iPad home screen.

It comes in two sizes (large and small) and features a cute little mascot.

Tap the widget and you'll be taken directly to a completely random Wikipedia article, with randomizer mode switched on.

No need to leave the app and tap the widget again. Just press the randomizer button, and it'll roll a virtual dice for you, so you can keep exploring down this random rabbit hole.

Enjoy it at your own pace—but watch out, you might lose track of time! Earlier this summer, the Wikipedia app also added a history trivia quiz game.

You can find this new widget in the latest update of the Wikipedia iPhone and iPad app.
